Nothing has changed since we spoke on November 9. Order Shop···· is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Your Hammer Miner Thor P2 still ships November 30, 2026, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA goes out with it.

It's waiting on the next batch of Thor P2 stock to arrive at our Netherlands warehouse. Since it ships from inside the EU, you won't owe import VAT or duties when it's delivered. You can follow that batch at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and we'll email you tracking as soon as your order ships.
